targets.title: Do State‐Customized TANF Work Policies Actually Reduce Unemployment?
targets.evidence_quote: The original purpose of this project was to expand on Kim and Berry's research regarding TANF policies. Methods I created a dataset that closely matched Kim and Berry's original dataset.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: The inclusion of fixed effects and trend variables, which Kim and Berry reported using in their model, caused the WSP variable to become about 0 percent and insignificant.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: The results of the synthetic control methods provided additional evidence that questions the validity of the original findings.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Reconstructs the original observational dataset and applies its reported model, which produces materially different numbers; alternative synthetic-control analyses also challenge the original conclusion.
